informal_statement: The arc-area function has derivative twice sine of the inverse angle.
reason: Equivalent in the declared constructor/section context. At MorgansArcFunction.lean:312-333, the source contract is `theorem hasDerivAt_arc {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) : HasDerivAt arc (2 * sin (θOf x)) x`. The unit-chord normalized area and arc length are constructed on 0 < theta < pi. The inverse is used geometrically only at positive area; its explicit totalization is not confused with an inverse outside that domain.
